effect_size.excerpt: The association between PLP and RCC risk was similar across the three models with an OR (90% CrI) for a 1 SD increase in log PLP of 0.72 (0.64, 0.82), 0.75 (0.66, 0.86) and 0.76 (0.66, 0.87) from the minimally adjusted, BMI and smoking adjusted, and mutually adjusted models, respectively (Table 3 ).
